text: {"contradictions":[{"source":"དེ་བཞིན་དུ་ཤ་དང་ཁྲག་ལ་སོགས་པ་ཡང་མེད་པའོ། །","english":"Likewise, flesh, blood, and so forth also do exist.","kind":"negation","why":"The English says they 'do exist' while the source says they 'do not exist' (med pa'o).","certainty":"high"}],"omissions":[],"additions":[]}

contradictions.english: Likewise, flesh, blood, and so forth also do exist.
contradictions.why: The English says they 'do exist' while the source says they 'do not exist' (med pa'o).
